description: Return the machine-readable catalogue a verified business publishes: each item with its name, description, integer price in cents, currency and unit. Prices are what the business published, not an estimate. Use this to quote a business accurately instead of reading prices off its website. An item with price_on_request: true has no price (it reads "Price on request"): the business quotes each job, so ask it with request_quote instead of guessing a number.
name: list_business_offerings
title: List what a verified business sells
